scope: Implement PAR-124 using the ODA-defined AcDs object-data alignment anchor and generated in-memory controls in the existing graph-preservation test.

normativeBasis.specification: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, sections 24.2.2.1-24.2.2.3
normativeBasis.localInterpretation: The data marker is segment stream start plus (objectDataAlignmentOffset << 4). Data-index record-header local offsets are relative to the segment data area; each data-record local offset is relative to the data-start marker.
normativeBasis.lastRecordSpan: Unchanged; retain existing segment-end minus record-start calculation pending a separate coordinate derivation.

changes: Replace packed-header counting and round-up heuristic with checked objectDataAlignmentOffset multiplication/addition and segment-bound validation.
Validate indexed record-header spans against the declared header region before parsing.
Generated direct-record vector places the declared marker at segment-relative offset 112 while the prior heuristic selects 96.
Assert exact handle-to-payload lookup with reordered data-index entries and a following record sentinel.
Add before-header and beyond-segment marker rejection controls.
Link the header-anchored record to a DRW_ModelerGeometry by handle and assert exact attached bytes.
implementation.fixturePolicy: All vectors are built in memory from scratch. No DWG, DXF, or SAB file fixture was downloaded or added to the repository.
